name: Angular
desc: From component fundamentals to signals, zoneless change detection, and the complete Angular 22 API — production v17 experience + everything that shipped since.
tip: Narrate your decisions when building live — 'I'd use OnPush here since state comes from an input signal, so change detection only fires when that signal updates.' That reasoning is what's graded at 4 YOE.

r: @for requires track. Missing track = compile error in v17+.
switchMap cancels previous. mergeMap runs all concurrently.
@Input reference change, async pipe emit, signal update, or manual markForCheck().
No Zone.js. Change detection driven purely by signals. Default for new projects.
form.value() is a signal. No subscribe needed. Stable in Angular 22.
Auto-unsubscribes on component destroy. Inject DestroyRef.
For non-class DI values (config, primitives, functions).
Lets a custom component work as a native form control with Reactive Forms.
